dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: *sob* I did not expect to be locked up in this cage... My dignity as one of the Masters of the Night-Wind is all but gone now, surely!

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: A disgrace to the tribe, a disgrace indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You again? What happened this time?

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Ah, my savior, we meet again... *sigh* I'm sorry you had to see that.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Ah, did I not say previously that my name is Conulaf, a trainee priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind?

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: As the name suggests, I'm presently in training to become a priest. And... Well, our tribal elders told me that my ancestor, Sanhaj, used to get into betting battles with people from other tribes, often tricking them silly in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: And so the elders said, "Go make and win some bets! That's the only way to qualify as a true Master of the Night-Wind!"

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: So when I passed by and saw a tournament taking place, I... I made a bet too. I mean, who cares if you've got a "defending Tepetlisaurus champion" or a "Qucusaurus, the decade's strongest rookie"...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Our Iktomisaurs would be the strongest, naturally!

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: That's what I thought, anyway... but I bet on the wrong Saurian.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Not only did I wind up in debt, but I got locked in here to boot...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: "Heh, tell you what," they said. "We'll give you ten times your Mora back if the Iktomisaurus emerges the champ. If not, you can just stay in this cage, alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: What should I do now? Oh, if only there was an Iktomisaurus who could give those other two Saurians a good thumping...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: That way, I could get out of here, and get ten times the Mora too! ... Ah, I mean, most importantly, we can't have those two tribes look down on our wonderful Iktomisaurs!

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: *sob* Please, dear savior. If you could find such an Iktomisaurus...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: *sigh* I probably shouldn't spout such nonsense. You're not of our tribe anyway — where are you supposed to just find an Iktomisaurus like that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll see about finding one...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: R—Really, could you? I—In that case, I'm just going to stay in this cage and wait for an update from you...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: R—Really, could you? I—In that case, I'm just going to stay in this cage and wait for an update from you...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Iktomisaurus makes a sudden, dynamic entrance and defeats the original victor, the "Crimson Dancer."\nAs agreed, the organizer frees the reckless young lady from the Masters of the Night-Wind...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: *sob* Ohhh... I thought I was about to be sent home in a cage, my family forced to pay my debts...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: And while I was in there, I suddenly remembered that our ancestors would stack the deck first before betting, which is how they'd win...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: So, yes, I had much time for self-reflection while in this cage — you know, about my unrealistic expectations of beating others at their own game.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: I don't know where you managed to find such a powerful Iktomisaurus...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: But I'm grateful all the same! With your help, I've recovered my investment, and even earned back ten times the Mora I put in!

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: I, on the other hand, barely did anything... But I'll need to find a soft bed to lie down on all the same. My back hurts all over from being stuck in this cage for half a day.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: As for the winnings, you keep them, dear savior! The elders said that keeping an unexpected windfall close will only bring one misfortune, so it's best I give it away!

dialogues.speaker: Excited "Children of Echoes" Warrior
dialogues.text: Come on, Gigadrill! You're the previous champ — no way you'll lose to that soft-looking Qucusaurus!

dialogues.speaker: Excited "Children of Echoes" Warrior
dialogues.text: That's it, Drill, that's it! Bob and weave, and look for an opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Oh great Sanhaj, please take pity upon your poor descendant... Guide my savior to <color=#00E1FFFF>a mighty Iktomisaurus indeed</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: May those from the other tribes who have humiliated your progeny be taught a lesson... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Calm "Children of Echoes" Warrior
dialogues.text: Odds are one to one-point-zero-five. Both sides are quite evenly matched in strength... But I'm hoping Gigadrill takes the win.

dialogues.speaker: Calm "Children of Echoes" Warrior
dialogues.text: Still, you saw how Crimson Dancer warded off Gigadrill's signature drill attack by ducking into its feathers — launched a counterattack right after, too.

dialogues.speaker: Calm "Children of Echoes" Warrior
dialogues.text: The situation's looking dicey for Gigadrill, I'd say...

dialogues.speaker: Relaxed "Flower-Feather Clan" Warrior
dialogues.text: Hmm? You're a new face. First time watching the contest? No rules here, mind, but if you lose the bet, then your Mora goes to the house, y'hear?

dialogues.speaker: Relaxed "Flower-Feather Clan" Warrior
dialogues.text: We had a lass from the Masters of the Night-Wind who couldn't pay up after losing a while back. You know where she is now? Bawling inside that cage, that's where.

dialogues.speaker: Focused Flower-Feather Clan Warrior
dialogues.text: Both sides are engaging full-force now, but if they keep doing that, it's going to take a huge toll on their endurance...

dialogues.speaker: Focused Flower-Feather Clan Warrior
dialogues.text: Hehe... Come on now... When do we get to see those finishing moves...

dialogues.speaker: Calm "Children of Echoes" Warrior
dialogues.text: Good, you're not seriously injured, and there's a sauro-vet clinic nearby... We'll do a complete checkup once we get there.

dialogues.speaker: Calm "Children of Echoes" Warrior
dialogues.text: But I can see that we've still got a long way to go, Gigadrill... Let's do this together.

dialogues.speaker: "Gigadrill"
dialogues.text: Wroo...

dialogues.speaker: Focused Flower-Feather Clan Warrior
dialogues.text: Heh... Feeling sore about that loss, are ya?

dialogues.speaker: "Crimson Dancer"
dialogues.text: Crooo...

dialogues.speaker: Focused Flower-Feather Clan Warrior
dialogues.text: That Iktomisaurus... *sigh* Can hardly believe such a strong one exists. Still, a loss is a loss. We'll just have to win next time!

dialogues.speaker: "Crimson Dancer"
dialogues.text: Grrawk!
